integrity: The block criterion is derived directly from the Rota-Baxter identity in arbitrary characteristic. The finite-field count and rank distribution are proved by a disjoint f=0/f!=0 stratification. A standalone verifier reconstructs the equations and exhaustively checks all operators over F2 and F3.
scientific_limitations: The finite-field census is restricted to the scalar almost-abelian three-dimensional Lie algebra, equivalently the k=-1 member of the cited g6 family.
The zeta identity is a rational-point count and does not assert an affine-space decomposition.
title: Finite-field Rota–Baxter census for the scalar almost-abelian three-dimensional Lie algebra
